derivation: At even N, the world diagonal y=m*x+c maps to pixel y=m*pixelX+(1-m+c)*N/2. Here m is even and c is integer. The intercept is integer, whereas pixel centers are integer+1/2. Their residual from the diagonal is therefore a half-integer, with minimum absolute residual 1/2 physical pixel for every 32/64/96 case. Computed before the fresh capture, independently of alpha outputs.
scope: Authored test geometry only; no alpha input, camera, node arithmetic, pixel mask or numerical gate changes. Raster edge ownership is not node-port credit.
